confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July high season in Albufeira, based on general knowledge and not on inspected listings or live prices. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because peak-season rates vary widely by date and property. The FX value comes from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA homepage for 15 Oct 2026. The RBA page itself was not opened, and a third-party figure for 16 Oct differs slightly, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: General knowledge of mid-sized Algarve coastal resort towns in Portugal in peak summer, such as Lagos and Portimão, adjusted upward for Albufeira's tourism-heavy venue mix.
